acceptanceCriteria: A host adapter with a real per-message receipt is invoked from an archive/delivery production path, and accepted or displayed states come from the receipt rather than capability flags.
Without a supported host send API, CLI and MCP continue to report full_handoff_only and unknown rather than claiming chat display.

A controlled end-to-end adapter test observes independent assistant-message events containing the complete localized body in order; retries resend only unaccepted segments and do not rerun archive or verification.
Chinese, Japanese, and English delivery uses the active conversation language without translating Contract or evidence facts.
Existing CLI/MCP query and archive semantics remain compatible.

End-to-end completion for the current Codex desktop conversation requires a host-provided send operation and a per-message receipt bound to the delivered Outcome; prepared events, a command-host fixture, or full_handoff_only do not satisfy this criterion.
authority: User standing authorization for in-scope implementation and lifecycle decisions recorded in conversation.
goal: Close the gap between prepared OutcomeDelivery events and verified host message delivery without altering lifecycle authority, evidence identity, or release behavior.
intent: Ensure that a Work Item archive produces a complete localized Outcome that is actually delivered as visible independent assistant messages whenever the current host offers a real send and confirmation interface; otherwise report the unsupported boundary truthfully.
outOfScope: No new generic message platform; no Codex or Claude API emulation; no release; no lifecycle or authorization redesign; no object-repository changes.
scope: crates/cockpit-agent/**; crates/cockpit-cli/**; crates/cockpit-mcp/**; crates/cockpit-protocol/** only where delivery contract requires it; focused delivery tests and documentation
